DIAGNOSIS READY: Laryngo-Tracheo-Bronchomalacia (LTTB) with associated Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD).

The combination of inspiratory stridor, worsening symptoms during neck flexion (dynamic compression), feeding difficulties, and vomiting is highly characteristic of this condition.
